subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support model/provider overrides for main-session systemEvent cron jobs, and if so should the contract be payload.model, top-level model/provider, or an explicit sessionOverride block?
rationale: Current code intentionally separates text-only systemEvent reminders from model-backed agentTurn payloads, and changing that affects provider routing, session override state, validation, persistence, UI, and docs.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Close or redirect this request and guide users to isolated or custom-session agentTurn jobs for per-job model selection.

options.title: Add explicit sessionOverride contract
options.body: Accept the feature but implement model/provider as a clear cron/session override surface with validation and upgrade-proof tests across main-systemEvent execution paths.

options.title: Overload systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Allow payload.model on systemEvent, but require a redesigned transport that avoids the closed PR's contextKey coupling and documents why systemEvent now carries model state.

recommendation.title: Add explicit sessionOverride contract
recommendation.body: Accept the feature but implement model/provider as a clear cron/session override surface with validation and upgrade-proof tests across main-systemEvent execution paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged cron normalization work preserved the current systemEvent boundary while handling adjacent model override behavior.
